description: Boundary fixture: 200.0 m car carrier under the Melbourne representative towage-demand rule. Tests that the helper produces the same result at the exact legacy threshold value as it does just below and just above (no rule discontinuity).
model_note: Representative tug-demand estimate ONLY. NOT an operational towage requirement. NOT a substitute for the Port of Melbourne Harbour Master's Directions (Edition 13.1, September 2023, §3.21).

expected.reasoning: Melbourne band 170-250 m yields n_tugs=2. Vessel-type-floor for Car carrier is 2. Same result as B1_pre_threshold and B1_post_threshold — the helper produces no boundary discontinuity.

boundary_role: value-at-threshold (the legacy literal `loa > 200` was strict greater-than; 200.0 was FALSE under the legacy rule). After R4.3 wiring, this vessel will have towage_required=true.
